title: UNEB Preparations: Structured Revision and Mentorship for Candidates
excerpt: Candidate classes follow a disciplined revision calendar, supported by timely assessments, past-paper practice and teacher mentorship.
body:
As the national examination season approaches, our candidate classes are following a carefully structured revision programme designed to consolidate learning, build confidence and sharpen examination technique.

Subject teachers are providing regular assessments, detailed feedback and targeted remedial support, while the Directorate of Studies monitors progress to ensure that every candidate is fully prepared for the Uganda National Examinations Board (UNEB) papers.

title: Academic Excellence Remains Our Hallmark
excerpt: A culture of high expectation, qualified teaching staff and consistent monitoring continue to anchor the academic life of the College.
body:
Academic excellence is at the heart of St. Leo's College Kyegobe. Through consistent lesson delivery, regular testing and close supervision, learners are encouraged to aim high and to take ownership of their progress.

Parents and guardians are warmly encouraged to partner with the College by supporting study routines at home and attending academic days and consultations.

title: The Library: A Quiet Engine of Independent Learning
excerpt: Learners are making greater use of the library for research, reading and supervised private study.
body:
The College library provides a calm and orderly environment where learners deepen their understanding, explore wider reading and prepare for assessments.

Teachers continue to promote reading and research as the foundation of lifelong learning, in line with our vision of academic excellence.

title: Basketball Teams Showcase Discipline and Teamwork
excerpt: Our basketball squads continue to train with purpose, balancing athletic ambition with academic responsibility.
body:
The College basketball programme remains a source of pride, with teams training regularly under dedicated coaches and participating in friendly and competitive fixtures.

Beyond winning, the programme emphasises fair play, leadership and respect for opponents, values that reflect the character we nurture in every learner.

title: Annual Marathon Unites Students, Staff and Alumni
excerpt: Participants of all ages gathered for a community marathon promoting health, fellowship and school spirit.
body:
The marathon brought together students, teachers, alumni and friends of the College in a vibrant celebration of fitness and community.

Events such as this strengthen the bond between the College and its wider family, while promoting healthy living among young people.

title: SLECK Alumni League Celebrates Fellowship Through Football
excerpt: Alumni teams returned to Kyegobe Hill to renew friendships and support the College through sport.
body:
The alumni league continues to be a meaningful platform for former students to reconnect, mentor younger learners and give back to their alma mater.

The College warmly appreciates the generosity and commitment of its alumni community.

title: Students Gather for Prayer and Reflection in the School Chapel
excerpt: Regular worship and reflection continue to shape the spiritual life of the College community.
body:
In keeping with our Catholic heritage, learners and staff gather in the chapel for Mass, prayer and moments of quiet reflection.

These gatherings nurture gratitude, moral courage and a sense of purpose, forming young people of strong faith and good character.

title: Prefects Commit to Servant Leadership
excerpt: The prefectorial body has pledged to uphold discipline, service and positive school culture.
body:
Prefects play an important role in sustaining order, modelling good conduct and representing the voice of learners.

Through mentorship and leadership training, the College prepares them to serve with humility, accountability and integrity.

title: Feast Day Celebration Brings the Community Together
excerpt: Worship, music and fellowship marked a joyful feast day celebration on campus.
body:
Feast days offer a cherished opportunity for the community to celebrate its faith, its traditions and its shared identity.

Learners, staff, parents and invited guests joined in prayer and festivities that reflected the warmth of the St. Leo's family.
